Samantha / Michael,

Thanks again for carving out time today — appreciate the candor from the leadership team. Below is a concise recap (for your execs) of the business outcomes you emphasized, the primary risks we discussed, and the suggested procurement path so we can keep momentum toward a Q4 pilot.

High-level attendees
- Samantha Rios (Head of AI Platform, Greenleaf Pharma)
- Michael Chen (CTO, Greenleaf Pharma)
- Hannah Schmitt (Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference)
- Laura Bennett (Solutions Lead, Redwood)
- Connor O'Brien (Sales Engineer, Redwood)

Key business outcomes (prioritized)
1) Reduce per-API inference cost by ~35-45% for batch/real-time workloads to hit operating targets for GenAI products.
2) Deliver consistent 95th-percentile latency under 120ms for patient-facing experiences.
3) Ensure controls for PHI handling and auditability (KMS / retention policies) to comply with internal security policy.

Top risks called out
- Procurement timeline and budget cycle: CFO sign-off required before November.
- Security evidence: legal/procurement expect SOC 2 + KMS details; any gaps will push timeline.
- Integration scope: existing middleware requires a short-run SOW and dedicated SRE onboarding window.

Procurement path & recommended next steps (our suggestion)
- Week 1 (this week): Share MOA draft + procurement checklist (attached). Hannah to loop in Redwood legal.
- Week 2: Procurement kickoff with Greenleaf procurement contact + exchange of SOC 2 / security artifacts.
- Weeks 3–4: Technical appendix + SOW draft (Conn or Laura to lead).
- Target: Procurement approval & signed MOA by end of October / early November to enable a Nov 15 pilot start.

Immediate asks for Greenleaf
- Confirm procurement contact and preferred contracting cadence (single PO vs. Master Agreement).
- Please share any mandatory contract clauses that must be surfaced to Redwood legal.
- Confirm whether the pilot will require on-prem/private deployment or if a dedicated-hosted instance is acceptable for initial scope.

Attachments sent with this message: greenleaf_moa_draft_v1.pdf; procurement_checklist.xlsx

I'll circulate a cleaned slide for your execs summarizing the above. If you want, I can format it as a one-page 'board-ready' briefing for Michael.

Thanks,
